name: Core
what: The essential classes that every site needs: View for DOM elements, Page for routing, Router for navigation, App for bootstrap, plus Sidebar, Search, Layout, Section, Item and List.

demos.shows: Router classes in action on real anchor tags

gaps: No interactive demo of View's capturing
Layout system explained but not browsed
Search and Sidebar shown as cards only
blurb: Ten core classes every site uses, one mental model.

stage.should_cap: The layout looks fine, centered well on 3440.

name: View
what: A chainable wrapper around a DOM element where HTML tags are functions and passing a function makes its content go inside.

demos.shows: Creating headers, paragraphs, lists, and styled buttons

gaps: Advanced lifecycle phases (prerender, initialize) not demonstrated
blurb: Every HTML tag is a function; pass a function for content.

stage.should_cap: The measure looks appropriate for documentation.

name: Page
what: A node representing a URL with content and children that can be navigated; every page.js file creates one.

demos.shows: 29 layout building blocks as clickable cards

gaps: Child navigation and routing not demonstrated
Data binding via page props not shown
Page word system only shown as cards
blurb: A URL with content and children; every page.js creates one.

stage.should_cap: The overview browse() uses a 60-cap that looks right; cards fit well at any width.

name: Router
what: Translates URL changes into page navigation by walking a tree of pages and writing CSS classes that guide styling.

demos.shows: Four real links with active/in-path classes lighting up

blurb: Everything between a URL change and the DOM reflecting it.

stage.should_cap: Measure width appropriate for doc content.

name: App
what: Bootstraps a site by running six lifecycle steps, building a container, and walking to the requested URL.
gaps: Lifecycle steps shown as text only
blurb: Boot and the one container pages mount into.

stage.should_cap: Content is at prose measure width.

name: Sidebar
what: A resizable component showing a brand and a tree of navigation links, with a footer that stays put and includes a theme toggle.

demos.shows: Two different Sidebars: hand-typed and tree-based, with resizing

blurb: A brand over links and a resizable edge; includes theme toggle.

stage.should_cap: Sidebars display at full width, no capping needed.

name: Search
what: A headless corpus of every page the Router can reach and a ranking system, plus an optional omnibox that lives on its own page.
features: Open search box with / or Ctrl-K
Search all pages in the corpus

demos.shows: Buttons to open omnibox and trigger corpus build, with stats

gaps: Search box interface not shown in demos
blurb: The site corpus and its search box, press / to open.

name: Layout
what: Thirty proven arrangements of boxes, each tested at seven widths with stress fixtures, defining where content can go and how it responds to resizing.

demos.shows: 30 layouts browsable, clickable to see at 7 widths

gaps: Stress fixtures not shown in browse
blurb: Thirty arrangements proven at seven widths; click to see one.

stage.should_cap: Browse uses 60-cap for cards which displays well at any width.

name: Section
what: A page you put inside another page that starts empty and lets you pick a layout to define its slots, into which you mount child content by name.
features: Pick a layout from live list
Mount children into slots by name

demos.shows: Empty section with editing, filled section with slots, example from JSON

gaps: Beneath floor behavior shown but not emphasized
blurb: A page inside a page; pick a layout to define slots.

stage.should_cap: Content at prose measure, looks appropriate.

name: Item
what: A persistent node of a document tree with data, children, and a saver, supporting nesting, movement, and event bubbling; runs in Node with no view.

demos.shows: Live assertions checking hydration, adoption, movement, events

gaps: Subclass registration shown but not interactive
blurb: A persistent tree node with data, items, and events.

name: List
what: The ordered collection behind item.items, an implementation detail of Item holding children and notifying the owner of changes.

demos.shows: Interactive demo reordering, nesting, renaming items with live redraw

gaps: Reactive lists intentionally cut, not shown
Direct list mutation (not via Item) shown but discouraged
blurb: The ordered collection behind item.items, an Item detail.

stage.should_cap: Buttons and tree output stay in measure.

name: core/new
what: A design proof directory where the first real versions of Router, Page and App were tested; not to be imported, kept for reference only.
gaps: Prior design tiers not explained interactively
Comparison to current code not shown
blurb: Design proof archive; do not import. Read only.
